capabilities.limits: Sourced bounded helpers; consult advanced-mechanics.md for volleys. Fractional-Build vehicles and source-specific exceptions remain source-dependent.

capabilities.name: D&D SRD 5.2.1 core
capabilities.limits: Core table procedures, Fighter build and advancement examples, ledger replay. Does not include non-SRD books.

capabilities.limits: Source-bound reader covers 12 class ranges and 339 spell entries when the verified PDF is available. Multiclass slots, fixed HP and Counterspell helpers; not every class/spell interaction.

capabilities.name: Trail of Cthulhu
capabilities.limits: Creation, pools and investigation procedures; source-specific safe-rest and psychotherapy helpers in corpus-adapters.md. No full campaign certification.

capabilities.name: City of Mist v0.75 quickstart
capabilities.limits: Quickstart moves, tags and statuses; full theme questionnaires and long-term advancement are outside this source.

capabilities.name: Fate Condensed
capabilities.limits: Creation, actions and aspects; bounded consequence absorption/recovery helpers. No exhaustive stunt or campaign validation.

capabilities.name: Blades in the Dark
capabilities.limits: Core actions/resistance and bounded vice/downtime helpers. Full crew, trauma and flashback interactions remain uncovered.

capabilities.name: Local homebrew adapters
capabilities.limits: Edition-bound interfaces and selected local_rules.py operations. No complete GugDove, Jiangshan or other homebrew engine.

capabilities.name: Other systems and older editions
capabilities.limits: BRP, older D&D, Pathfinder, Warhammer and other materials require source-specific edition and topic checks. Extraction is not rule verification.

capabilities.name: Optional corpus and handout processing
capabilities.limits: PDF, scan/OCR, CHM and old DOC adapters depend on available tools; card audit and recipient manifests. Full-text caches stay private.

capabilities.name: Historical creation and scene packs
capabilities.limits: Three reviewed example packs, six CoC7 builds and nine scenes; configured arithmetic does not establish historical truth or semantic clue sufficiency.

capabilities.name: Original rulebook and design lab
capabilities.limits: Explicit manifest dependencies, conflict repair and dream-game prototype. Undeclared prose contradictions and general balance are not automatically certified.

capabilities.name: Persistent session ledger
capabilities.limits: Atomic sourced events, revisions, replay, rollback and audience projection. Stores adjudicated outcomes, not complete action legality.

capabilities.name: Evidence dependency audit
capabilities.limits: AND/OR dependencies, unseeded cycles, missing evidence, bottlenecks and split knowledge. Declared logic only; not proof of fictional persuasiveness.

capabilities.name: Branch-aware recap and next preparation
capabilities.limits: Read-only current facts, active events, source revisions and explicit prep notes. No automatic inference of beliefs or triggering of GM plans.
